Finance Minister Meets US Business Leaders, Pitches India as Investment Hub

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman met with US business leaders, including the CEO of 3M, to promote India as a manufacturing and innovation hub. The discussions focused on exploring opportunities for expansion in advanced manufacturing and research and development within India. Sitharaman pitched the country as an attractive investment destination to the executives.
